Section 270(15): Where a regular assessment under sub-section (10) or section 271 is made,— Section 270(15)(b): if no refund is due on regular assessment or the amount refunded under sub-section (1) exceeds the amount refundable on regular assessment, the whole or the excess amount so refunded shall be deemed to be tax payable by the assessee and the provisions of this Act shall apply accordingly.
